title: Speculative Model Risk in Healthcare AI: Using Storytelling to Surface Unintended Harms

bias_targets.methodology: Generating speculative user stories that highlight AI failures related to cultural contexts (e.g., dietary preferences, emotional expression) and analyzing whether human participants identify these cultural harms during a speculative model card completion task.

Qualitatively coding participant responses in a red-team discussion and model card task to measure their ability to anticipate allocative harms, such as disparities in healthcare access or economic losses based on socioeconomic status.

Evaluating human participants' ability to foresee representational harms, including stereotyping, demeaning, or erasing specific demographic groups, after engaging with multi-agent narrative scenarios.
